subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

We are all aware that our environment are not what it used to be.
solution:
The correct answer is __**environment are not**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence formation should be "We are all aware that our environment *is* not what it used to be", in place of **are** it should be **is**.
 
• Environment is a singular word and with **singular words "is"** is used.
 
• **"Are" is used with plural words** not singular words.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A singular noun is a word that refers to one person, place, thing, event, substance, or quantity.

Examples : Lisa bought a pencil yesterday, Dan and Sid gave me chocolate.

 
• A plural noun is a word that refers to more than one person , place , event or thing.

Example : All the buses are parked in parking area , My mother got me few dresses yesterday.
